items.title: Contraction of an exceptional curve of the first kind preserving projectivity and quasi-projectivity

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an exceptional curve of the first kind inside a fibre of a finite type morphism over a Noetherian base can be contracted while preserving projectivity, respectively quasi-projectivity, of the source over the base (statement lines 4985-4996). The proof (proof lines 4998-5047) contracts the curve over an affine open, glues the result with the complement of the curve, verifies properness by localness on the base and glues the invertible modules to obtain a relatively ample module, and reduces the quasi-projective case to a projective model. H2: a glueing argument with three inputs, written out in full.
